# External catalogue research, batch 1 — 2026-10-02

Finite batch: inspect rKTs G60 plus its collection context; preserve 29 fetched catalogue pages, 12 manifestation rows. Completed: 29/29 HTTP fetches and 12/12 location rows. Remaining: physical scans, edition identity, same-print/independent-witness distinctions, and unindexed collections. No textual proofreading or collation performed.

The G60 work record confirms 11 collection sigla and 12 BDRC sets. `manifestations.csv` transcribes the catalogue locations; line numbers are separated by HTML subscript in the raw record and therefore appear as spaced numbers in the CSV. The original HTML is authoritative for those details. Each fetched file has URL and SHA-256 in `provenance.json`.

Important caveats:
- Two Derge sets have the same pagination: MW1ER7 and MW21939. They are not automatically independent editions.
- `Gns` (gnubs gsang sngags chos gling; MW1ER27) and `Gnu` (Nubri) are separately listed collections; do not equate them from spelling.
- Gadkar's collection page displays set MW1ER156 but its external BDRC link points to MW1BL6; the G60 work page uses MW1ER156. Resolve this catalogue discrepancy before scan acquisition.
- Gtb/MW21521 (Tshamdrak), Gtk/MW21518 (Tingkye), Ggy/MWEAP039-1-3-2 (Gangtey II), Ggm/MWEAP105-1-1 (Drametse), Gsg/MW1KG16449, Gts/MWEAP310-4-1 (new Tshamdrak scans), Gcd/MW21520, Ggb/MW3CN3207 are listed collection leads, but G60 currently has no indexed manifestation for them. Absence from the G60 work record does not show absence of the tantra.
- Ggi, Ggp, Gnu, Gna, Gdk, Gpg have collection stubs with no sets displayed. These remain leads, not confirmed String of Pearls witnesses.
